description: The plot illustrates the comparison of Loss against TFLOPs for two different models, labeled Vanilla and SepLLM. The x-axis is labeled "TFLOPs" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0.00 to 1.25, with a multiplier of $10^9$ indicated at the far right, and tick marks spaced at regular intervals of 0.25. The y-axis is labeled "Loss" and uses a linear scale ranging from 2.40 to 2.75, with tick marks at intervals of 0.05 and corresponding horizontal dashed grid lines. The plot contains two solid lines. The line representing Vanilla is purple with square markers; it begins at approximately 0.05 on the x-axis with a y-value of roughly 2.73, decreases sharply until about 0.25 on the x-axis, and then continues to decline more gradually, ending at an x-value of 1.25 with a y-value of approximately 2.53. The line representing SepLLM is red with circular markers; it starts at an x-value of approximately 0.05 with a y-value of roughly 2.70, follows a similar initial sharp decline followed by a gradual decrease, and ends at an x-value of approximately 0.98 with a y-value of roughly 2.53. Additionally, an annotation featuring green dashed lines connects the end point of the SepLLM line to the Vanilla line at the same y-value, accompanied by the green text "1.28$\times$".
